scenario: Golden vector AF-1 (specs/conformance/SERIES_SIGNAL_VECTORS.md), read by a rule: `active_fraction sliding 5_min` over a pump held true over (0, 240 s] and then false, read at 300 s, is 240/300 = 0.8. It is time-weighted, not the fraction of true samples (LSIG.1.3.2), and the (t-W, t] left-exclusive boundary makes the start at t-W contribute nothing (LSIG.2.2.4). Each sample is asserted at its instant and pumped; at 300 s a `Probe` arrives and `read` logs the binding's `active_fraction` as of that firing ([NSBK.6.3]: a series' value reaches an integrator only through a rule).
rules_ds:
use default

schema Pump scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

schema Probe scope explicit:
    k: Int

series Pump.state:
    active_fraction sliding 5_min

rule read:
    Probe
    Pump p
->
    log info "{p.active_fraction}"
